verdict.rationale: The API reference documents a version-prefixed endpoint (POST /v1/search), which suggests URL-based API versioning, but nothing describes a versioning scheme or any deprecation policy. The agent, environment and suite versioning features cover a different capability and do not count here. Missing for 10: a documented API versioning policy, a deprecation policy and timelines, changelog or sunset notices, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
